start.title: A Voice in Sleep
start.text:
An angel speaks in your dream:
"Rise. Herod seeks the child."

choices.text: Sleep on, it is only a dream
choices.feedback: Heaven does not lie.
Matthew 2:13 — An angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and told him to rise, take the child and his mother, and flee to Egypt.
There is no time to wait.

ignore_consequence.title: Rise Now
ignore_consequence.text:
The danger is real and near.
Do not delay.

choices.feedback: You sit up suddenly.

wait_consequence.title: Trust the Word
wait_consequence.text:
Heaven has already spoken.
Move now.

choices.feedback: You throw off the blanket.

wake.title: Wake the Mother
wake.text:
Mary sleeps with the child near.
There is no time to lose.

choices.text: Wake Mary and prepare to flee
choices.feedback: Matthew 2:14 — Joseph rose, took the child and his mother by night, and departed for Egypt.

choices.text: Hide the child in the house
choices.feedback: No wall will stop Herod.

hide_consequence.title: Flee, Do Not Hide
hide_consequence.text:
The angel said to leave the land.
Obey the word.

choices.text: Wake Mary and prepare to flee
choices.feedback: You shake her gently awake.

flee.title: Out of Bethlehem
flee.text:
Moonlight falls on empty streets.
The child sleeps in Mary's arms.

choices.feedback: Soldiers may already be near.
Matthew 2:14 — Joseph took the child and his mother by night and departed for Egypt.
Stay off the open road.

warn_consequence.title: Go Quietly
warn_consequence.text:
Your task is to save the child.
Leave at once.

choices.feedback: You vanish into the dark.

main_road_consequence.title: Hidden Paths
main_road_consequence.text:
Soldiers patrol the open ways.
Keep to the shadows.

choices.feedback: You take the small back paths.

road.title: Toward the South
road.text:
The desert stretches before you.
Egypt lies far beyond.

choices.text: Turn back, the road is too far
choices.feedback: Do not turn back now.
Matthew 2:14 — Joseph departed for Egypt with the child and his mother.

turn_back_consequence.title: Forward Only
turn_back_consequence.text:
Behind you is danger.
Ahead is safety.

choices.feedback: You walk on with Mary.

rest.title: By the Oasis
rest.text:
Water glints under the rising sun.
The child must drink.

choices.feedback: Do not stay too long.
Matthew 2:14-15 — Joseph departed for Egypt and remained there until the death of Herod, fulfilling what the Lord had spoken by the prophet.
You go together or not at all.

linger_consequence.title: Move On
linger_consequence.text:
The border is still far away.
Keep going.

choices.feedback: You fill your skins and rise.

send_back_consequence.title: Stay Together
send_back_consequence.text:
She and the child are your charge.
Never leave them.

choices.feedback: You take her hand and walk on.

egypt.title: The Land of Egypt
egypt.text:
Pyramids rise in the rose dawn.
You have crossed the border.

choices.text: Find a humble home and stay
choices.feedback: Matthew 2:15 — Joseph remained in Egypt until the death of Herod.
Hide, do not boast.

court_consequence.title: Stay Hidden
court_consequence.text:
The child must grow in quiet.
Find a humble place.

choices.text: Find a humble home and stay
choices.feedback: You knock at a small house.

safe.title: Safe in Egypt
safe.text:
The child sleeps under a warm lamp.
He is alive. He is safe.
